title: klndr
seoDescription: klndr, a visual day planner for time-blocking: drag activities onto an hour-by-hour timeline. Built with Nuxt, Firebase, and Tailwind.
summary: A drag-and-drop day planner for time-blocking.

modules.text:
klndr is a visual day planner for time-blocking. It connects the month calendar with an hour-by-hour plan, so each day is shaped by dragging activities onto a timeline rather than managing a to-do list.

Key features:
• Month view with an at-a-glance summary of each day's blocks
• Day view with a quarter-hour timeline, where activities snap, stretch and nudge with the arrow keys
• Reusable activity templates for emoji, color, category and typical length
• Daily routines checklist and markdown notes for every date
• Google sign-in with sync across devices
• Light and dark themes, with bottom sheets and tap-to-place on mobile
• Landing page with scroll reveals and a live planner preview

Tech stack: Nuxt 3, Vue 3, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Firebase (Auth and Firestore), signed session cookies with jose.

title: Dokr
seoDescription: Motion-first marketing site for Dokr, a digital banking brand, built in Next.js with GSAP and Framer Motion.
summary: Motion-led marketing site for a digital bank.

modules.text:
Dokr is a marketing website for a digital banking brand. It presents a fee-free account, cards and wealth tools as one clear story, with motion used to reinforce the brand's modern positioning.

Key features:
• Letter-flip preloader and mask-reveal headlines
• Parallax product artwork with smooth scrolling powered by Lenis
• Sections for payments, investing, wealth and planning, fee-free promises, cards, social proof, a join call to action and FAQ

Tech stack: Next.js 13, React 18, TypeScript, styled-components, GSAP, Framer Motion, Lenis, Geist.

title: Realster
seoDescription: Marketing site for a Greater Boston real estate brokerage with search-led home discovery built in Next.js.
summary: Real estate site for finding homes in Greater Boston.

modules.text:
Realster is a marketing website for a Greater Boston real estate brokerage. It helps buyers discover homes, explore neighborhoods, book viewings and connect with agents, with a premium feel rather than a plain listings feed.

Key features:
• Search-led hero that opens into listings, private exclusives and neighborhood guides
• Agent profiles, a how-it-works section, FAQ and contact flow
• Motion and smooth scrolling throughout

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion (Framer Motion), Lenis.

title: Photofolio
seoDescription: Motion-first photographer portfolio in Vue 3 for portraits, editorial, and documentary work.
summary: A motion-first portfolio for a portrait photographer.

modules.text:
Photofolio is a motion-first portfolio for a freelance photographer. It leads with portraits, editorial stories and documentary coverage, and makes booking a shoot the clear next step.

Key features:
• SVG wipe loader and split-text hero with a Book a shoot call to action
• Sticky service cards for portrait sessions, editorial and campaign work, and events and documentary coverage
• Selected works index with viewport-triggered video previews
• About, testimonials and a full-bleed contact section
• Custom cursor, magnetic buttons and scroll-linked type

Tech stack: Vue 3, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP (ScrollTrigger), Lenis, Lottie.

title: KnowYourGeo
seoDescription: Free GeoGuessr training app with Street View drills, AI coaching, and field guides.
summary: Free GeoGuessr trainer with AI coaching and field guides.

modules.text:
KnowYourGeo is a free training app for GeoGuessr players who want to improve, not just chase a score. Players practice on Google Street View, place guesses on a map and review each round to see which clues they missed.

Key features:
• Map pickers for world or continent rounds
• Moving / No Move and timer constraints
• AI round review that highlights street signs and regional meta
• Field guides and player profiles that log sessions and weak spots
• Email and Google sign-in
• AI analysis runs on secured, rate-limited server routes, so API keys never reach the browser

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Google Maps and Street View, Google Gemini, Supabase Auth, Upstash Redis.

title: Songrates
seoDescription: Music discovery app for rating songs and albums, backed by Apple Music charts and Supabase profiles.
summary: Rate songs and albums, powered by Apple Music.

modules.text:
Songrates is a music discovery app built around one loop: find a song or album, then rate it. Ratings build a shared catalog of opinions, playlists and fully rated releases.

Key features:
• Home feeds with trending tracks, country Top 100 playlists and community-rated albums
• Album pages with track-by-track scoring, reviews and playlists
• Artist follows and public profiles with a leveling system unlocked by fully rated albums
• Guests can rate; signed-in users keep their progress and unlock profile perks

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase (auth and database), Apple Music API, TanStack Query, React Three Fiber for upcoming 3D vinyl experiences.

title: Digio
seoDescription: Marketing site for Digio, a next-generation design agency, built in Next.js with Three.js, Motion, and Lenis smooth scrolling.
summary: Design agency site with 3D and smooth scrolling.

modules.text:
Digio is a marketing website for a next-generation design agency offering branding, mobile and web app design. It is built to win premium clients from startups and category leaders, with a bold first impression and a clear path to booking a call.

Key features:
• Motion-driven hero, agency intro and by-the-numbers proof
• Six-part services list and selected-work showcase
• Tiered monthly pricing, testimonials, FAQ and a journal
• Smooth scrolling, entrance animations and a 3D layer

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Three.js with React Three Fiber and Drei, Motion, Lenis, React Icons.

title: VSCS
seoDescription: Bilingual marketing site for a solar EPC company. Next.js frontend with a Strapi 5 CMS.
summary: Bilingual solar company site on a Strapi CMS.

modules.text:
VSCS is the company website for VS Construction Services, a Bulgarian solar EPC business. It explains the turnkey photovoltaic offer, showcases completed projects, publishes news and turns visitors into consultation requests and leads.

Key features:
• Bilingual Bulgarian and English content
• Services, project map, blog, careers and form flows
• All content editable from a Strapi CMS
• Frontend revalidates when content changes, so copy and media update without a full redeploy

Tech stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Strapi 5, i18next, Mapbox, GSAP, Lenis, Nodemailer (SMTP forms). The local CMS uses SQLite; production targets PostgreSQL.

title: Mikrofond
seoDescription: Production WordPress site for a Bulgarian microfinance company. Designed in Figma, built in Elementor Pro.
summary: WordPress site for a Bulgarian microfinance company.

modules.text:
Mikrofond is the company website for a major Bulgarian microfinance institution. It presents financing products, electronic food vouchers, company information, news and contact flows for businesses that need a production-ready brand site.

Key features:
• Full visual design in Figma, refined over several months with the client
• Fully responsive WordPress build in Elementor Pro
• Entrance animations, animated statistics, dynamic layouts and custom graphics
• Production hardening: speed optimization, asset compression, anti-spam protection and Google Analytics

Tech stack: WordPress, Elementor Pro, Figma.

title: Collection of Landing Pages
seoDescription: A Figma collection of landing page concepts across SaaS, retail, and entertainment, showing how I approach design and UX in one file.
summary: Landing page concepts for SaaS, retail and entertainment.

modules.text:
A Figma collection of landing page concepts across very different industries. It shows a clear approach to hierarchy, conversion and visual tone, from dark SaaS to retail and entertainment.

Key features:
• Ten complete landing pages in one showcase
• Dark-mode product interfaces, a Japanese snack subscription, an interior studio, a recipe platform, B2B consulting layouts and a designer portfolio
• Simple structure, custom components and type that stays clear at a glance

Tools: Figma.

title: Kallos
seoDescription: Kallos is an e-commerce admin dashboard built with React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4, featuring interactive Chart.js charts and light and dark themes.
summary: E-commerce admin dashboard with interactive charts and light and dark themes.

modules.text:
Kallos is an admin dashboard for e-commerce teams, built with React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4. It brings sales, channel, category and store performance into one overview.

Key features:
• Interactive Chart.js line and bar charts with a shared palette, gradient fills, grids and tooltips
• Each chart includes a legend and resizes to its card
• Light and dark themes that switch instantly, backed by one visual system

Tech stack: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Chart.js.
